_note: An allowance paid in money with the salary, and salary under S2 s.16 / 1961 s.17(1); for an employee paid by the Government, its deduction for TY 2025-26 is SAL-ENTMT-ALLOWANCE (1961 s.16(ii); D-105). From TY 2026-27 the Act has no deduction, so the compiled year keeps only its SAL-SALARY-INCLUDES reference. In no salary base, being an allowance. CASH: paid in money (DR 05 M2).
head: SALARIES
